name: Square Shine UI Buttons
summary: Two square shop/index buttons with shine, animated inner strokes and falling/click icon effects.
install: Move Shop Rebirth UI ScreenGui into StarterGui. Its Phone folder contains IndexButton and ShopButton. Position the buttons for your HUD and connect your own navigation callbacks. No rebirth, shop or purchase backend is included despite the original root name.
limits: Native button assets and original effect scripts retained. Actual purchase/rebirth functionality and mobile/gamepad behavior are unverified.
credit: Original supplied filename, root names and scripts are preserved.
verification: Static Studio Edit inspection on isolated clones; no runtime behavior certification. Native instance counts/root names matched the supplied imports. Original scripts were disabled on static preview clones.
